email_body:
Hi Bryon,

I noticed that A Forty Something Frenzy sends bookstore owner Angie Daly through a portal into a fae realm to track down a stolen pen of lore. A cozy, found family take on portal fantasy with a middle-aged heroine feels like a fresh and welcome angle. Your background as a former magazine editor who now writes from the Jersey shore makes the story behind it even more interesting.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for A Forty Something Frenzy is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit A Forty Something Frenzy best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
